items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts OUT (blood clot/calf) vs Panthers; Tanner McKee to start, Milton signed for depth.
items.why: Superficial blood clot confirmed; ruled out earlier in week.
items.implication: McKee starts; less rushing upside for PHI offense.
items.opportunity: WR/TE targets may rise in pass-heavy script.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday vs Panthers after missing all practices; Will Shipley also to IR.
items.why: Missed full week of practice with hamstring; confirmed by team report and Schefter.
items.implication: Eagles backfield thinned with Shipley IR; volume to remaining RBs.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for healthy PHI RBs in committee.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled OUT vs Rams; resting for long-term healing per coach.
items.why: No practice multiple days; intentional rest.
items.implication: ARI RB depth chart shifts; check backups for volume.
items.opportunity: Increased role for other Cardinals RBs.

items.text: Ravens ruled out QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) for Sunday at Browns; no practice this week, Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Missed all practices; ankle sprain from prior week.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens offense less dual-threat upside.
items.opportunity: Stream opposing defense or Huntley if desperate.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith listed IN/no designation after upgrade to full/limited practice; expected to return vs Panthers.
items.why: Practiced Friday without designation after missing prior games (hamstring/toe).
items.implication: Reclaims primary WR role opposite others.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery OUT for Week 6; listed among Sunday outs.
items.why: Groin or related; confirmed on ETR final list.
items.implication: HOU RB committee shifts to others.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining HOU backs.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from commissioner exempt list Monday; eligible to practice/play Week 7.
items.why: Investigation remains open but cleared for return post-Week 6.
items.implication: Stash for ROS; potential lead back Week 7+.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown QUESTIONABLE; status 'up in the air' heading into Week 6.
items.why: Practiced but final call pending per reports.
items.implication: Monitor Saturday; big swing if active.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevates other NE pass-catchers.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation and is clear/IN for Sunday at KC after limited work earlier.
items.why: Full clearance on final report despite prior foot issue.
items.opportunity: Reliable WR2/3 with target share intact.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant Friday but officially QUESTIONABLE vs Falcons; needs final clearance.
items.why: Hamstring; practiced fully multiple days but listed Q.
items.implication: Game-time or Saturday decision; high upside if active.
items.opportunity: If IN, strong matchup vs ATL pass D.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Kyren Williams (RB5) vs ARI for elite recent usage and soft run defense matchup.
items.why: Volume trending elite; ARI leaks vs run.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start with goal-line upside.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Drake London (WR6) vs CHI citing bankable usage in favorable spot.
Matthew Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle (WR28) vs SEA due to tough matchup and QB uncertainty.
items.why: Seattle secondary problem; shaky QB situation.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Mike Evans (WR4) vs WSH; Commanders D is buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak WAS secondary.
